SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
S & D. B. Station,
No. S. B. D. 1945.
Date January 21, 1931.
Time 22 - 7 - 31.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Mr. D.S. Zelberg and Miss Sarah D. Zelberg.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by W. Ounear W.P.I.

Sir,

Information has been received to the effect that
D.S. Zelberg, Russian Jew, is a suspected Soviet Agent and
collects information of an economical character regarding
living conditions in Shanghai. He has business connections
with the Centrosojus and "Dalbank."

His daughter, Miss Sarah Zelberg, recently joined
the staff of the local branch of the "Dalbank" as a typist.

It is said that Mr. Zelberg's brother, being a
Communist, was executed in 1918 or 1919 by the White Russian
Government of Ataman Semenoff in Chita Transbaikalian Province.

Both reside at Park Apartment, No. 455 Rue Lafayette,
Ap. 12.

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

Reg. Please file. Copies will be
handed to the usual authorities.
J.M.G.
22:1:31.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号
S & D. B. 分局，
编号 S. B. D. 1945。
日期 1931年1月21日。
时间 22 - 7 - 31。

报告

事由（全称） D.S. Zelberg 先生与 Sarah D. Zelberg 小姐。

呈报人 D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人 W. Ounear，W.P.I.。

敬启者：

接获情报称，
D.S. Zelberg，俄籍犹太人，系疑似苏联特工，
收集有关上海生活状况的经济性质情报。他与“Centrosojus”（中央消费合作总社）及“Dalbank”（远东银行）有业务往来。

其女 Sarah Zelberg 小姐，近期受雇于“Dalbank”（远东银行）本地分行，担任打字员。

据称，Zelberg 先生的兄弟因是共产党员，于1918或1919年在后贝加尔省赤塔被阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenoff）的白俄政府处决。

二人均居住于拉斐德路455号派克公寓12室。

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C.（刑事与特务科）

批注：请归档。副本将送交常规主管当局。
J.M.G.
31年1月22日。
